listing.name: BigBeans Ship Compilation
listing.summary: A pack of ships painted and kitbashed mostly by myself with a few outside donations. Attempts to be as balanced and vanilla friendly as possible.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large collection of new ships, skins, and weapons for use in fleets across multiple factions.

description:
BigBeans Ship Compilation - Main ship pack

DOWNLOAD

:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pynD5MzQyjPRbah1bH2pFQWIKXtgBGqU/view?usp=drive_link

Current Version: v0.1.98.85

v0.1.98.8 NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE WITH ANY VERSIONS BEFORE!

REQUIRES: LazyLib

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

A collection of various ships and skins created and edited by myself. Also includes a couple sprites gifted to me by other spriters. This is my first mod. I am willing to take suggestions for new ships and to listen to balance feedback and bug reports but this is very much a hobby project so don't expect constant updates.

SHIPS:

Spoiler

Terringzean

, Large battleship with an imposing presence, primarily used by the Hegemony.

Threave

, A Low Tech battlecruiser used mostly by the Hegemony.

Nadir

, A large donut shaped exploration capital cut from the same cloth as the smaller Apogee. (Thanks to Banano for the original version of this sprite)

Ardea

, A capital sized midline fleet carrier.

Brigand

, a scrappy pirate raiding battlecruiser.

Adventurer

, A long range exploration leader designed to fight off pirates and discover new worlds!

Maraka

, Fast low tech cruiser with a frontal Large Composite mount and good survivability. Stepping stone between Eradicator and Dominator.

Commandant

, A low tech command cruiser.

Ruswall

, A low tech missile spamming cruiser.

Constable

, A superheavy destroyer that's as old as the Vanguard, right click damper and all.

Chrysaor

, Destroyer sized EMP emitter.

Kingpin

, a wide high tech destroyer with a similiar profile to an Enforcer.

Australis

, A bulbous cruiser with a focused energy armament.

Carnyx

, a wide set carrier just keep it away from direct combat.

Bogle

, a very light escort gunship.

Tungustan

, A long ranged artillery cruiser with a potent energy beam but little else. (Thanks to Banano for the original version of this sprite)

Cassina

, heavily armed destroyer leader.

Buzzard

, A heavily armed cruiser straddling the line between a Falcon and an Eagle. (Shape is based on a ship from Seafood Ship Pack, check that mod out).

Preybird

, a light battlecarrier designed to assist the Falcon and Eagle.

Accipiter

, a destroyer sized light battlecarrier.

Aghast

, Interdictor cruiser, Phaseships begone!

Strix

, Midline heavy frigate.

Hartfell

, A decent choice for a line frigate. Also comes in Pirate.

Marauder

, a pirate raiding destroyer.

Brigantine

, A large pirate cruiser for scaring patrols. Its size belays its weaknesses.

Cumulus

, a light support and exploration destroyer, very much a mini-apogee.

Gallivanter

, A high end explorer and support frigate.

Roamer

, A civilian grade light cruiser designed to protect trade ships and accompany mining and exploration fleets.

Haven

, a destroyer sized Shepherd style drone carrier.

Baldric

, a medium sized cargo vessel utilizing cargo technology from the Atlas.

Baldric MK.II

, a combat conversion of the Baldric into an unshielded missile cruiser.

Lockout

, A civilian grade escort destroyer desgined for convoy protection and anti-piracy duties.

Carnal

, A heavy frigate with suprising bite and staying power. Has an XIV version.

Timberwolf

, An attempt to turn the Wolf into a far more survivable assault ship.

Killskipper

, Be careful who you make a fool of at school.

Covetor

, miner turned convoy escort.

Shalloch

, a rare high tech advanced destroyer.

Bitzer

, a tiny patrol ship, more of an annoyance than a threat but cheap as chips. Has two little drones friends to help it in combat.

Hedgehog

, Cheap and cheerful Mudskipper conversion. Point Defence escort on a budget.

Tramp

, the cheapest cargo container with an engine you can buy.

Tramp MK2

, A Tramp turned into a "dangerous" warship.

[close]

WINGS:

Spoiler

Stobo Heavy Fighter

, Broadsword 2.

Sturgeon Heavy Bomber

, a large low tech bomber dropping a powerful unguided armoured bomb.

[close]

On top of that there are also a number of ship skins for Pirates, Hegemony, Lions Guard and Luddic Church and Path to add variety to common enemy fleets.

Spoiler

[close]

WEAPON:

Spoiler

Sabot MLMS

, exactly what it sounds like.

[close]

Changelog

:

SpoilerBSC 0.1.98.8

Fixed Linux crash caused by Stobo missing a capital letter.

Added Ardea-class capital fleet carrier for Persean League and Mercs.

Added Strix-class heavy frigate for Persean League and Independents.

Added Haven (P) for Pirates (Blaster Pod and it's Hullmod from PMMM with permissions from Minideth)

Regular Haven now has Medium Missile slot.

Hammerhead Mk.II, Hammerhead (LP), Buffalo MK.III and Mudskipper Mk.III removed.

Maraka sprite updated (with some help from Birdwanderer)

Basic Maraka now has a large ballistic, while XIV has Composite.

Drudge sprite updated. +10OP to account for new medium mount. Drudge renamed to Australis-class.

Roamer sprite adjusted and armament adjusted. Gains one medium missle but loses two small ballistic.

Roamer + variants stats adjusted, now roughly 75% of a Venture but 10DP. LP version 12DP.

Roamer + variants now have Burn 8 instead of 7.

Lockout stats are generally now roughly 50% of a Venture but it is now 7DP. LP version 8DP.

(These Lockout and Roamer changes are subject to buffs/nerfs depending on how they perform now)

Covetor, Lockout and Roamer should all spawn a bit less, especially for Hegemony.

Brigand speed nerfed 50<60. Was way too fast.

Starliner Mk.II back to 10DP but it got a notable stat nerf to hull, armour and flux.

Baldric cargo nerfed, 850<750. Before it was too good compared to Colossus.

Overseer renamed to "Commandant" as new [THREAT] Cruiser is called "Overseer".

Overseer/Commandant speed changed 55>60, should've been that in the first place.

Overseer/Commandant given mount and weaponry changes, drones upgraded and massive DP buff 18<25.

Fixed Overseer/Commandant "Support" variant having converted hangar (can't use it due to drone wing).

Fixed Bogle [REDACTED] version not unlocking in Codex

Tungustan built in weapon should definitely not drop in salvage or dealers now.

Sturgeon adjusted, heavy bomb should be more accurate and powerful.

Small buff to Cassina by giving its front hardpoints 10 degree more fire angle.

Cassina and (LG) variant now 12DP.

Constable and (P) variant now 12DP.

Some ships have had their Blueprint availability changed.

BSC 0.1.98.7

Updated for Starsector version 0.98

Removed Atticus as I did not like it, also Adventurer exists which has similar role.

Removed Brave, it was forgettable. I basically was trying to make the Wren-class from "Disassemble Reassemble" but mine was really generic looking and lame.

Removed Bitzer (LC) skin, pointless.

Removed Sword as I didn't like its role or sprite, might return at some point.

Added Hedgehog, a mudskipper based escort frigate, might need tuning, might be too weak.

Added Overseer Command Cruiser.

Added Ruswall Missile Cruiser.

Added Stobo Heavy Fighter.

Threave completely re-sprited, loses a pair of medium mounts.

Updated Nadir sprite.

Updated Tungustan sprite.

Updated Bitzer sprite. Now renamed to Blitzer (As I noticed everyone called it that), has an extra small mount, 5 more OP.

Coyote name changed to Timberwolf (very important) and improved its sprite. Med Synergy changed to Med Energy.

Improved/adjusted Marauder (Refit) skin.

Cassina, Brigantine and Constable have been resized. Cassina loses 2 smalls. Smaller size helps all these ships in combat as they can get more weapons on target.

Terringzean loses 4 small mounts.

Brigand speed nerfed 70>60

Maraka speed buff 50>60

Baldric MK.II now has ALWAYS_PANIC tag so it should spam missiles more. Also fixed its crew requirements.

Starliner MK.II is now 12DP

Bogle and [REDACTED] buffed up quite a bit. Both were under-stated and almost useless.

Tungustan base speed dropped to 60 to 55 and its base beam range is dropped to 1500. Should no longer try to shoot fighters with its main beam weapon.

Tungustan built in beam does not appear in salvage exploration drops anymore.

Roamer+variants get +10 OP.

BSC 0.1.98.6

Added Buzzard-class Cruiser.

Added Aghast (LG) Skin.

Added Marauder (Refit) Skin.

Updated Cassina (LG) Skin.

Brave stats edited. Hull-2500(!!!)>1600, Armour-250>200, Max Flux-2000>1800, top speed-120>125. System-Flares>M-jets. It was a bit strong for 3DP, should be a bit more balanced now.

Increased Aghast System range to 1400.

All (LG) ships now have Solar Shielding built-in at Cost, like Vanilla.

Nebula MK.II reduced to 6DP.

Increased Sturgeon bomb explosion size.

BSC 0.1.98.5

Added Haven-class Drone Tender.

Added Sturgeon-class Heavy Bomber

Added Constable (P)

Changed Shalloch Sprite, gave it custom trails and reworked its system into energy aaf.

Made Threave sprite smaller as it was quite big for a battlecruiser.

Baldric MK.II now has flare launcher instead of Burn Drive.

Terringzean small stat changes, 1950>2000 armour and 28000>30000 hull, 24500>25000 max flux.

Tungustan beam should now generate flux.

Gallivanter DP reduced by 1.

Cumulus has 5 more OP.

Killskipper, Sword, Gallivanter and Carnal (XIV) should be more rare.

Maraka is now 20 DP. 10 More OP.

Threave changed to 8 burn like other battlecruisers.

Sabot MLMS is now 26 OP, same as Cyclone Reaper Launcher.

BSC 0.1.98.4

Added Maraka (XIV)

Added Sword-class heavy frigate.

Completely resprited Accipiter, gave it a more unique look rather than mini-eagle.

A couple of other smaller sprite updates.

Bitzer base speed slightly nerfed to 190 instead of 195 as I was finding them annoying to catch while playing.

BSC 0.1.98.3

Updated for Starsector 0.97a

Fixed a rare CTD.

Added Accipiter destroyer battlecarrier.

Resprited Starliner MK.II and Nebula MK.II

Covetor buffed, speed to 120 and price to 9800.

Cumulus speed buffed, cargo buffed, decreased OP.

Gallivanter has had slight stat buff across the board to try and make it more useful.
